title: Move backend hardcoded settings to configuration
decisions: PAYMENT_OTP is mandatory at startup; a missing or blank value causes startup validation to fail before database connection, and no production fallback OTP is retained.

DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_CODE defaults to 1 for local compatibility and can drive the employee browsing alias /api/departments/employees; the existing explicit /{departmentCode}/employees API remains unchanged.
PORT defaults to 8090 to preserve the current backend behavior; PAYMENT_OTP, DEFAULT_DEPARTMENT_CODE, and PORT are documented in dotenv.env and dotenv.example.
Pagination defaults/maxima are shared typed-rule constants. Existing model fields were reviewed and none were removed: affected fields remain part of JSON or persistence/API contracts.
compatibility: Existing payment, department, authorization, and explicit pagination API behavior is preserved except that payment OTP is now supplied by environment configuration.
